description: Any product idea, checked against today's app-store charts and against what DECA's own products measured. The idea is placed by meaning next to the apps climbing the charts; back come facts with sources, not an opinion: the closest apps and where they rank, the demand pattern they belong to and its heat, what their users complain about, what people search for that nobody answers, how crowded the field is. Free.

name.description: The product's name, if it has one.

pitch.description: Who it is for and what it does for them, in a few sentences.
